title: SC3: A Multi-Solvent Solubility Challenge and Benchmark
description: SC3 is a multi-solvent solubility benchmark built on BigSolDB v2.1. It provides a reproducible curation pipeline that groups literature measurements by independent source, Gold/Silver/Bronze consensus tiers with per-point uncertainty, leakage-checked benchmark splits, a per-solvent metric suite, a Croissant 1.1 metadata file, and the code for a 31-model benchmark. Accompanies the NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track paper.
